name: avatar-group
title: Avatar Group
description: Overlapping stack of avatars that spreads out on hover, shows each name in a tooltip, and collapses extra people into a +N chip.

props.name: items
props.description: People in the group. Without src, the initials of name are shown.

props.name: max
props.description: Number of avatars shown before the rest collapse into a +N chip.

props.name: size
props.description: Avatar size of 32, 40, or 48 pixels. The overlap scales with it.

props.name: groupLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the group, such as "Project members".

props.name: moreLabel
props.description: Hidden text on the +N chip for screen readers. {count} is replaced with the number of hidden people.

a11y: The stack is a group with an accessible name from groupLabel.
Each avatar is an image named after the person (alt or role img with aria-label), so screen readers do not need the tooltip.
Tooltips and the visible +N are aria-hidden; the chip announces moreLabel instead.
With reduced motion, the spread and lift happen instantly without a transition.

ai.whenToUse: Showing who is on a project, assigned to a task, or reacted to a post, in a compact row.
rules: Pass every person in items and let max decide how many are visible
Set groupLabel to describe the people, such as "Assignees"
On a surface other than canvas, set the ring color with the --avatar-ring custom property, such as [--avatar-ring:var(--color-surface)]
Leave room above the group for the tooltip

id.description: Tumpukan avatar yang mengembang saat hover, menampilkan nama di tooltip, dan meringkas sisa orang menjadi chip +N.

props.items: Orang di dalam grup. Tanpa src, inisial name yang tampil.
props.max: Jumlah avatar yang tampil sebelum sisanya diringkas menjadi chip +N.
props.size: Ukuran avatar 32, 40, atau 48 piksel. Tumpukan ikut menyesuaikan.
props.moreLabel: Teks tersembunyi di chip +N untuk screen reader. {count} diganti jumlah orang yang tersembunyi.

a11y: Tumpukan berupa group dengan nama aksesibel dari groupLabel.
Setiap avatar adalah gambar bernama orang itu (alt atau role img dengan aria-label), jadi screen reader tidak butuh tooltip.
Tooltip dan +N yang terlihat memakai aria-hidden; chip membacakan moreLabel.
Dengan reduced motion, efek mengembang dan terangkat terjadi seketika tanpa transisi.

ai.whenToUse: Menampilkan siapa saja di proyek, yang ditugaskan, atau yang memberi reaksi, dalam satu baris ringkas.
rules: Masukkan semua orang ke items dan biarkan max menentukan berapa yang tampil
Isi groupLabel sesuai isinya, misalnya "Penanggung jawab"
Di atas latar selain canvas, atur warna ring lewat custom property --avatar-ring, misalnya [--avatar-ring:var(--color-surface)]
Sisakan ruang di atas grup untuk tooltip
